sloka: अहं सुग्रीवसचिवो हनुमान्नाम वानरः ।प्रविष्टो नगरीं लङ्कां लङ्घयित्वा महोदधिम् ।। ५.३४.३९।।।।
transliteration: ahaṁ sugrīvasacivo hanumānnāma vānaraḥ ।praviṣṭo nagarīṁ laṅkāṁ laṅghayitvā mahodadhim ।। 5.34.39।।।।

translations.english: "I am Sugriva's minister known as Hanuman, a vanara who entered the city of Lanka after leaping over the great ocean.
